name: Nakata Sae
source:
A friend and classmate of Miya's. Having studied at an all-girls school for most of her life, Sae is incredibly shy around men. Because of that, she has a soft, quiet voice. Though generally reserved, she shows a child-like enthusiasm for the Inago Mask superheroes.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amagami]Wikipedia[/url]]
